test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Please take __many__ as you want.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e., "as much".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence "Please take many as you want" is incorrect because "many" is used with countable nouns and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct phrase to use here is "as much," which fits the construction "as much as you want," used to indicate an unspecified amount.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Please take as much as you want.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options do not fit the context:
 
 
• "too much" implies an excessive amount, which is not suitable in this context.
 
• "so much" does not fit grammatically within the given sentence structure.
 
• "much of" is incorrect and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
 
• Using "as much" correctly indicates no limitation on the amount, ensuring the sentence is grammatically correct and clear.
